title: Hardcoded swap path might not be the most optimal/liquid one
summary: ## Proof of Concept  Currently in `NyPtvFantomWftmBooSpookyV2StrategyToUsdc` the value of the `booToUsdcPath` trade path is not configurable and is basically hardcoded to be `[BOO, USDC]`. It is the same for the swap router, as it is currently hardcoded to point to the SpookySwap router. The problem is that the `BOO/USDC` pool on SpookySwap might not be the most optimal and liquid one, and maybe instead it would be better to go `BOO/USDT` and then `USDT/USDC`.
